fixture: ground 8x2x8 / 128 cells, dedicated server parity harness
method: Sequential 3/5/7 lift using the live plan and control law: SubLevelKineticLiftProfile.planTarget, KineticStructureControl.settings, gravityCompensatedTarget, StructureDirectControl.Anchor. Each tier requires 200 consecutive ticks with |rise - height| <= 0.1.
massTierNote: Control settings use the smallest tier whose mass budget admits the body; heights remain 3/5/7. Local mass 128 -> control tier 0; Sable mass 256 -> control tier 1.

invalidSample.reason: Sable mass 256 at control tier 0 has maxForce 2000, below its weight; rise stayed ~0 and the probe hit its deadline. Not a control regression: the live Sable skill rejects tier 0 for that mass via sableLiftMassRejected. The probe now selects the mass-adequate control tier for settings.

limitations: Server-side parity harness only; no real H player input, camera, client rendering, network, or Sable live tier-0 skill (which the mass gate rejects). The local 3/5/7 live skill path still needs in-game acceptance.
